name: elmdb-workspace
description: The tooling that builds and tests elmdb's binding (crates/elmdb-node) and EARS (packages/ears), kept out of the packages it builds so that a project linking either installs none of it

scripts.build: npm run build:binding && npm run build:ears
scripts.test: npm run test:binding && npm run test:ears
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:binding && npm run typecheck:ears
scripts.typecheck:binding: tsc --noEmit --strict --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 crates/elmdb-node/protocol/*.d.ts crates/elmdb-node/index.d.ts crates/elmdb-node/client.d.ts && tsc --noEmit --strict --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --target es2022 --allowJs --checkJs crates/elmdb-node/test/schema-types.test.mjs crates/elmdb-node/test/client.test.mjs crates/elmdb-node/client.js
